name: Lottomatica Group Spa
summary: Incorporated in 2019 and based in Rome, Italy, Lottomatica Group S.p.A. operates as a significant entity within the Italian gaming market. The company structures its diverse operations across three primary segments: Online, Sports Franchise, and Gaming Franchise. Its Online division offers an extensive array of digital games, including sports betting, virtual betting, horse racing, casino games, bingo, poker, betting exchange, and skill games, all accessible through platforms such as GoldBet.it, Better.it, Lottomatica.it, and Betflag.it. The Sports Franchise segment provides a variety of retail-based betting services, encompassing sports, virtual, and horse race betting, distributed under the brands GoldBet, Intralot, and Better. Furthermore, the Gaming Franchise segment oversees the management of physical gaming halls and holds the concessions for operating video lottery terminals (VLTs) and amusement with prize (AWP) machines. Lottomatica Group S.p.A. functions as a subsidiary of Gamma Intermediate Sarl.
